c74object.name: evi_biquad.genexpr
c74object.digest:
evi_biquad.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the "evieve" Package.
It is for using in a codebox or in another .genexpr file via the "require()" command.
By declaring require("evi_biquad.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in the evi_biquad.genexpr file.
